stages.name: LEARN
stages.desc: ground from disk/memory/live data before acting

stages.name: CHECK_EXISTING
stages.desc: audit what's already built; never rebuild

stages.name: AUDIT
stages.desc: trace claims, catch overclaims, RUNNING/DESIGNED/STUB split

stages.name: IMPROVE
stages.desc: log pass/fail, tighten loop, propose (not self-commit) (PDCA g5)

bft_rule: cross-lineage checkers only; escalate-don't-average; log rho; rho>=0.7=theatre
honest_scope: governance+throughput, NOT capability; params don't add across stacked brains
